from_notes: Giorgia Meloni: PM since October 2022 (after elections of 25 September 2022); first woman PM; longest continuously serving PM in Italy's post-war history (Sep 2026).
x: Giorgia Meloni (Brothers of Italy, centre-right) became Italy's first woman Prime Minister in October 2022, after the elections of 25 September 2022, and is still PM in 2026. Emma Bonino, Rosy Bindi and Laura Boldrini are Italian politicians who never held the post.
source: Praveen CA-360 Sep 2026 p.9 (Italy PM: Giorgia Meloni); Rocket CA 2026 Part 01 p.74 (PM Giorgia Meloni, May 2026)

x: Exam keys and GK books give the Indian Mackerel as India's national fish, so it is keyed. Hilsa is the State Fish of West Bengal and the National Fish of Bangladesh; Pomfret and Rohu are not national symbols.
dispute: Official key / most books: Indian Mackerel. Strictly: the Government of India has not notified any national fish (the Ganges river dolphin is the national aquatic animal; Golden Mahseer has only been proposed) — web search found no official listing.
source: printed key, not verified (no official notification found in a web search); app notes 6:64 sub 4 (Hilsa = State Fish of West Bengal, National Fish of Bangladesh); PMF Species pan-02 p.8 (Golden Mahseer = national fish of Pakistan)
evidence: Web search: no official 'national fish of India' notification; Tribune: Ganges river dolphin = national aquatic animal

from_notes: Ann Daniels and Caroline Hamilton (British): first women to walk to both poles (2002).

from_notes: Indo-UK JETCO (Joint Economic and Trade Committee) – constituted 13 January 2011 to boost India–UK trade, investment and economic cooperation.
x: The India–UK Joint Economic and Trade Committee (JETCO) was established on 13 January 2005, launched in New Delhi by Kamal Nath and Patricia Hewitt after the 2004 Joint Declaration; it meets annually. 13 January 2011 is wrong (the printed key and the old notes).
evidence: Web search: Business Standard 17 Jan 2005 'Indo-UK body to reduce trade barriers'; siliconindia 'India-British economic, trade panel launched' (Kamal Nath, Patricia Hewitt, 13 Jan 2005)
Local library: no JETCO entry in Rocket CA, Praveen or PMF (grep)

from_notes: Chancellor Friedrich Merz – 10th Chancellor (6 May 2025), elected only in the second round of the Bundestag vote – a first since World War II.
x: On 6 May 2025 Merz failed to get a majority in the first Bundestag ballot, the first time this had happened in post-war Germany, and won the second round with 325 votes. Several CDU leaders were Chancellor before him (Adenauer, Kohl, Merkel), he is not the youngest, and the Chancellor is elected by the Bundestag, not by popular vote.
source: app notes 6:66 sub 5; aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/6/germanys-merz-elected-chancellor-in-second-round-vote (search result); Rocket CA 2026 Part 01 p.74 (Chancellor Friedrich Merz visit, Jan 2026)
evidence: Web search: Al Jazeera, The National, AP 6 May 2025
